description: This chart represents the win rate percentages of GPT-4o compared to LLaMA and Mistral. Structured as a nested donut chart, it displays a total of four slices divided across two concentric rings surrounding bolded central text that reads "Win rate (%)". The outer ring consists of two slices: a dominant dark blue-gray segment labeled "GPT-4o: 96.8%" and a small light blue segment positioned near the top labeled "LLaMA: 3.2%". The inner ring similarly contains two slices: a heavily dominant dark red segment labeled "GPT-4o: 98.4%" and a very small beige segment near the top labeled "Mistral: 1.2%". There is no standalone legend or percentage labels situated inside the slices; instead, external text labels detailing the category and exact percentages are placed around the chart and connected to their respective sections using straight black leader lines. None of the individual slices are visually exploded or offset, and within both rings, the segments are visually organized such that the vastly larger proportion occupies almost the entire circumference, leaving the minimal contrasting slice located at the top center.
